toolsPreview.name: lookup_country_calling_code
toolsPreview.description: Look up international country calling codes by free text, ISO code, dial code, or region. Optionally return reviewed, source-linked dialing examples. This tool does not verify live subscriber numbers.

toolsPreview.name: format_international_phone_number
toolsPreview.description: Normalize a phone number into a plausible international format using reviewed country-specific rules. Processing is ephemeral. This tool does not query carriers, HLR/HSS, MNP databases, or live subscribers.
